question: What character flaws reduce a person to a mockery of the Kula scripture?
premises: The person is driven by greed.
Such a person becomes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
inference: One who seeks out of greed and remains fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement of capalā with the subject is contextually implied.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
